title: TombstoneEntity payload
description: Typed payload for the tombstone-entity operation kind (registry code 3). Soft-delete an entity or relationship by supersession (not erasure). Fields are grounded in the OpPayload::TombstoneEntity inline variant in crates/mneme_core/src/ops.rs. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC as a decimal string.

entity_id.description: Node or edge instance to tombstone. The suppressed fact remains resolvable at a belief before the tombstone.

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).
